findings.title: Generic Quality loses inferred survey context when source-kind storage is absent

evidence.risk: mixed task can activate first monitoring dataset after generic Quality navigation despite prior survey context

findings.impact: A legacy/remounted mixed task with saved precision stage but no source-kind key can switch from survey to auto when Quality is opened; activeDataset then becomes first monitoring dataset and delivery readiness/input payload may change.
findings.recommendation: Have generic Quality preserve the effective source mode (including inferred survey), or initialize/persist source-kind before the stage change; add a stage-only mixed-task regression test.

conclusion: Patch correctly makes generic Quality mode-neutral for persisted monitoring/survey modes and explicitly selects monitoring for dataset evidence/import. One legacy storage edge remains as above; focused tests pass but do not cover it.
